data.title: Labor Force Participation rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Indicator name
metadata.value: Labor Force Participation rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually

metadata.label: Indicator description
metadata.value: This indicator measures the labor force participation rate for residents in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi  Labor Force Participation rate: It represents the proportion of the working-age population (15-64 years) that is either employed or actively seeking employment

metadata.label: Keywords
metadata.value: Labor force participation rate, Labor force, participation rate

metadata.label: Statistical population
metadata.value: The statistical population includes all individuals aged 15 years and above who reside in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The following are excluded: visitors to the Emirate who have stayed for less than six months, residents of institutions such as hospitals, psychiatric facilities, elderly care homes, orphanages, and hotels, members of the diplomatic corps, armed forces personnel, security camps, and palace residents.

metadata.label: Geographic coverage
metadata.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.

metadata.label: Statistical calculation method
metadata.value: [Labor force residing in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually / Working-age population residing in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually]  x 100

aiRecommendation.title: Expand Programs to Sustain Labor Force Participation
aiRecommendation.title_ar: توسيع البرامج للحفاظ على مشاركة القوى العاملة
aiRecommendation.text: Rising labor force participation rates reflect a healthier economy, but continued investment in training and inclusivity is needed to sustain and accelerate this trend.
aiRecommendation.text_ar: تعكس معدلات مشاركة القوى العاملة المتزايدة اقتصاداً أكثر صحة، غير أن الاستمرار في الاستثمار في التدريب والشمولية ضروري للحفاظ على هذا الاتجاه وتسريعه.
aiRecommendation.reason: Participation rates have grown steadily from 78.5% to 80.8% between 2021 and 2024, indicating more residents are actively engaged in the labour market. Policy focus should continue on skills development and removing barriers to participation.
aiRecommendation.reason_ar: ارتفعت معدلات المشاركة بشكل مطرد من 78.5% إلى 80.8% بين عامي 2021 و2024، مما يشير إلى تزايد مشاركة السكان في سوق العمل. ينبغي أن يستمر التركيز على تنمية المهارات وإزالة العوائق أمام المشاركة.
